Problem.description: The standard error shape of every failure (RFC 9457, rest-api.md 3-9).

title.description: A short English line for logs; screens build their words from code and params.

params.description: The values a screen needs to write the message.

trace_id.description: The trace id, the same as the X-Trace-Id header.

errors.description: One entry per wrong field of the input.

FieldError.description: One wrong field of a request.

pointer.description: A JSON pointer to the field, or the query parameter name.

code.description: The code of this field's problem.

params.description: The values a screen needs to write the message.

Meta.description: The meta of an answer that is not a KG answer: only the trace id is always there.

trace_id.description: The trace id, the same as the X-Trace-Id header.

ItemMeta.description: The meta of a single resource of the type registry.

trace_id.description: The trace id, the same as the X-Trace-Id header.

model_hash.description: The hash of the model the answer was read from; the ETag is made from it.

allowed_actions.description: What the caller may do with this resource now. A hint for screens; the server judges again on every request.

ListMeta.description: The meta of a list of the type registry.

trace_id.description: The trace id, the same as the X-Trace-Id header.

model_hash.description: The hash of the model the answer was read from; a cursor of another model hash is refused.

AllowedAction.description: One action the caller may or may not do, with the reason when not.

action.description: The action name, such as edit.

allowed.description: Whether the caller may do it now.

reason_code.description: Why not, from GET /v1/catalog/reason-codes; null when allowed.

ResultComplete.description: How much of a list this answer holds (rest-api.md 3-2, 3-3).

total.description: How many items match the filter, without those hidden from the caller.

returned.description: How many items this page holds.

truncated.description: Whether the answer was cut by a limit other than the page size.

reason.description: Why it was cut, when truncated.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

AsOf.description: Which state of which KG an answer reads (KG answers only).

generation.description: The generation, which rises on every point-in-time restore.

change_seq.description: The last change number the answer includes.

sealed_version.description: The sealed KG version, when the answer reads one.

volatile_as_of.description: Whether volatile values are current or omitted.

Freshness.description: How old the sources of an answer are (KG answers only).

worst_source_id.description: The source with the oldest data.

oldest_age_seconds.description: The age of that data in seconds.

state.description: The worst state among the sources.

Evidence.description: The grade of the facts behind an answer (KG answers only).

min_grade.description: The lowest grade used: fact, assumed or unknown.

counts.description: How many facts of each grade.

kinds.description: The kinds of evidence behind the facts.

items.description: configured, observed, declared and so on.

observation_age_seconds.description: The age in seconds of the oldest observation.

Hidden.description: Whether the caller's scope hid something from the answer.

hidden_passed.description: Whether the path went through something hidden.

hidden_reached.description: Whether something hidden was a match.

hidden_passed_count.description: How many hidden objects the path went through, when the caller may know.

hidden_reached_count.description: How many hidden objects matched, when the caller may know.

ServedBy.description: Which role of the product answered.

Operation.description: A long-running job returned with 202 and a Location header (rest-api.md 3-7).

created_at.description: When the job was created, UTC.

expires_at.description: When the job and its result disappear, UTC.
